articles.title_zh: 利用监督目标领域适应措施,在多中心非连结CT上进行Ichemic Stroke分离和净取水量量化
articles.content_zh:
目标:对包括净水吸收(NWU)在内的非连续计算成像仪(NCCT)的梗死低密度进行定量评估,需要人工或半人工的损伤划定,通常以CT输液或传播加权磁共振为指南,限制临床适用性。 自动分解NCCT可以有效提取诸如NWU等生物标记器,但跨多中心不同数据仍具有挑战性。 这项研究旨在开发并外部测试关于NCCT的中风分化的域认识深度学习框架,并评估其是否适合NWU量化。
材料和方法: 在对来自四个数据集的801名患者进行的回顾性多中心研究中,从汉堡-埃彭多夫大学医疗中心和急性Ichemic Stroke数据集,对基于nU-Net的模型进行了NCCT扫描培训。 为了适应新的领域,该模型在来自波士顿(n=11)和ISLES(n=75)的目标域子集上进行了微调,对搁置案例的评价没有用于微调. 将自动化分解值和NWU值与专家参考值作了比较。
结果: 30毫升的损伤中位数为0.68(波士顿)和0.56(ISLES)。 在ISLES中以较小的损伤为主,包括急性损伤分解(波士顿数据集)的中位剂量为0.54(中间值范围[IQR]0.30-0.70),与治疗后梗塞(ISLES挑战的主要目标)相比,NCCT损伤分解为0.20(IQR 0.03-0.41)。 自动NWU表示绝对误差1.37个百分点(SD 1.61,波士顿).
结论:目标域的适应支持只针对不同外部组群的NCCT梗塞分化,尽管不同领域的业绩各不相同。 该方法使低敏度的NCCT从基线NCCT中量化,但没有先进的成像,从而支持了进一步的临床评估。

articles.title: Task-Oriented Semantic Feature Transmission for Multi-Task Satellite Remote Sensing over Low-SNR Channels
articles.content: Conventional satellite remote sensing transmission follows a reconstruct-then-infer paradigm that optimizes pixel-level fidelity, creating an objective mismatch with downstream tasks such as classification and detection, especially at low SNR. This paper investigates a task-oriented framework that bypasses image reconstruction and directly transmits semantic features extracted by a multitask-pretrained backbone. A lightweight channel adaptation module (CAM) compresses feature dimensionality for bandwidth reduction, and a feature restorer recovers task-relevant structure after channel corruption. With the backbone frozen, the CAM and task-specific downstream heads are jointly optimized with task and feature-level supervision under random-SNR training. Under the adopted AWGN setting, experiments on scene classification and object detection show consistent gains over reconstruction-oriented JSCC baselines across different SNR conditions, with the largest improvements in the low-SNR regime.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 面向任务的多任务卫星低分辨率遥感语义特性传输 频道
articles.content_zh: 常规卫星遥感传输遵循一种重建-当时的参照范式,这种范式优化了像素水平的忠诚度,造成了与分类和探测等下游任务的客观不匹配,特别是在低SNR. 本文调查了绕过图像重建的任务导向框架,并直接传输由多任务预修骨干提取的语义特征. 轻量级信道适应模块(CAM)压缩功能为减少带宽的特性维度,功能恢复器在信道腐败后恢复与任务相关的结构. 随着骨干冻结,CAM和任务特定下游头部在随机-SNR训练下与任务和特征级监督共同优化. 根据所采纳的特设工作组的设置,现场分类和物体探测实验显示,在SNR不同条件下,与面向重建的JSC基线相比,取得了持续的进展,在低SNR制度方面,进展最大。

articles.title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
articles.content: Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cortex上的连接模式:表面磁共振磁共振到PET的翻译,并带有扩散桥
articles.content_zh: 由FDG-PET(英语:FDG-PET)所测的氟代氧葡萄糖分泌分泌分泌(Floorodoxyglucose Positron Element Tomography)是用于痴呆症诊断的高度敏感的生物标志. 然而,高昂的费用、辐射照射和有限的可获取性限制了其临床效用。 虽然磁共振成像(MRI)的跨模式合成提供了一个很有希望的替代方法,但现有的体积生成方法并没有明确地说明与疾病有关的模式主要存在的高折叠皮质几何学。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了新型的地表扩散桥框架DB-SUiT,用于核磁共振对PET的翻译,在皮层多面上本土运作。 一个有条件的球形U形视觉变形器(SUiT)专门设计,用于在保存表面地形的同时模拟复杂的跨模式关系. 它结合了球状演化编码器,用于多尺度的表面特征提取和瓶颈变形器,以捕捉远距离的空间依赖性,同时结合了人口学和亚理论条件来完善合成. 评估了两个数据集,包括具有不同痴呆类型的主题,DB-SUiT显示的高真性合成大大超过其他基线。 在自动痴呆分类中,合成的PET表面比核磁共振性能提高14.2%,PET卷比11.3%,接近真实的PET表面性能. 在一项失明读物研究中,合成PET实现了85.5%的诊断精度,而核磁共振为75.8%,真正的PET为95.2%。 这进一步表明交叉症状和交叉病理学的概论,因为对该模型的评价没有再培训外部群体,其中包括在培训期间没有代表的痴呆亚型。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT上查阅。

articles.title: Cross-Modal Attention Acts as a Frequency Filter: Why Verbose Prompts Improve Robustness in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are fragile under image corruption. We find that the wording of the question affects VLMs in two opposite ways. Verbose questions make VLMs substantially more robust---e.g., rephrasing "Is there a cat?" into "Please look carefully and answer: is there a cat?". Conversely, VLMs become more fragile under corruption when the question is semantically complex or finer-grained, e.g., "what colour is the cup left of the chair?" instead of "is there a cup?". Both effects stem from question-conditioned cross-modal attention, which induces a spectral filter over image patches: verbose questions broaden its frequency support, while fine-grained questions concentrate it onto fewer visual scales. The model's answer drifts most when this filter and the corruption sit on the same spatial frequencies. We test the filter view on Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-OneVision across GQA and CLEVR; verbose paraphrasing reduces drift variance by 70--81% on the 8B models. The practical recipe---pad the prompt---further yields measurable gains in accuracy, even under image corruption.

articles.title_zh: 作为频率过滤器的跨潮流注意行为:为什么Verbose Points在视觉-语言模型中改善强健性
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在图像腐败下是脆弱的. 我们认为,问题的措辞以两种相反的方式影响到自愿终止措施。 Verbose问题使得VLMs更强壮得多——例如,将"有没有猫?"重写成"请仔细看并回答:有没有猫?". 反之,VLMs在腐败下变得更加脆弱,当问题过于复杂或细腻时,例如"椅子的杯子剩下什么颜色?"而不是"有杯子吗?". 这两种效果都来源于有问题条件的交叉模式的注意,这诱导了光谱滤波器超过图像补丁:动词问题拓宽了它的频率支持,而细纹问题则将其集中在较少的视觉尺度上. 模型的答案在过滤器和腐败 处于相同的空间频率时最容易漂移。 我们测试在Qwen3-VL和LLaVA-One Vision上的过滤视图,横跨GQA和CLEVR;动词参数化将8B模型的漂移差异降低70-81%. 实际的配方 -- -- 快速的 -- -- 进一步在准确性方面产生可衡量的收益,甚至在图像腐败的情况下。

articles.title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
articles.content: Robotic reward models evaluate task execution from visual observations, but their predictions can change with camera viewpoint and occlusion even when the underlying task state is unchanged. Adapting a pretrained reward model to a local task therefore requires accounting for how that task is observed. We introduce AnyviewMeter, a geometry-conditioned adaptation framework for robotic reward models that represent task progress as a scalar reward signal. It combines low-rank fine-tuning with token-aligned Plucker rays and synchronous block attention: ray conditioning incorporates camera geometry into visual features and attention queries and keys, while block attention fuses synchronized views inside the pretrained decoder. The framework supports both single-view reward prediction and joint multi-view evaluation through parameter-efficient adaptation of a pretrained Robometer model. On PickCube, single-view adaptation improves progress prediction in every camera group and reduces mean absolute error under a changed field of view by approximately 21% relative to RGB fine-tuning. Across simulated manipulation tasks, joint multi-view prediction reduces progress error by 41-69% compared with averaging single-view RGB predictions and improves temporal ordering in approximately 88% of task-camera groups. On real tasks with fixed and wrist-mounted cameras, mean absolute error decreases by approximately 21% relative to averaged RGB fine-tuning. These results support camera geometry and joint visual evidence as useful components of task-specific robotic reward adaptation.

articles.title_zh: AnyviewMeter: 适应带有相机几何和多视度的机器人奖励模型
articles.content_zh: 机器人奖励模型从视觉观测中评价任务执行,但其预测可以随相机视角和隐蔽而变化,即使基本任务状态不变. 因此,要使事先经过培训的奖励模式适应当地的任务,就必须说明如何执行这项任务。 我们引入了AnyviewMeter,一个几何条件的适应框架,用于机器人奖励模型,代表任务进度,作为标尺奖励信号. 它将低档微调与符号对齐的Plucker射线和同步块注意相结合:射线调节将相机几何学结合到视觉特征和注意询问和键中,同时阻断注意引信在预训解码器内同步查看. 该框架支持单景奖励预测和联合多景评价,方法是通过参数效率调整预先训练的Robometer模型。 在PickCube上,单视调制改进了每个相机组的进度预测,并在一个变化的视域下将平均绝对误差相对RGB微调减少约21%. 在整个模拟操纵任务中,联合多视图预测比平均单视图RGB预测减少41-69%,并改进了约88%的任务-相机组的时令. 在使用固定和手腕挂相机的实际任务上,相对于平均RGB微调,意味着绝对错误减少约21%. 这些结果支持相机几何学和联合视觉证据作为任务特定机器人奖励改造的有用组成部分.

articles.title: A Smaller Transformer in Your Transformer
articles.content: Recent findings indicate that Vision Transformers settle into locally similar computational phases, implying a level of depthwise computational redundancy. However, existing methods to exploit this redundancy either fail to reduce inference compute or severely degrade model expressivity. In this work, we formalise a unified view of block redundancy that decouples the geometry from specific surrogate interventions. We then introduce Transformer-Within-Transformer (TWT), a post-hoc method that fuses contiguous groups of redundant layers into a single learned surrogate layer. TWT reduces parameter count and inference compute while remaining competitive with original models using half the depth on natural images, and in several downstream histopathology settings, TWT matches or even improves on the original baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 您的变形器中一个较小的变形器
articles.content_zh: 最近的调查结果表明,Vision Transformers已进入当地类似的计算阶段,意味着深度的计算冗余程度。 然而,利用这种冗余的现有方法要么不能降低推论计算,要么严重降低模型的表达性。 在这部作品中,我们将块冗余的统一观点形式化,将几何与特定的代位干预脱钩. 然后,我们引入变形器-Within-Transformer(TWT),一种后热法,将毗连的冗余层组融合成一个单一的学习过的代位层. TWT减少参数计数和推论计算,同时保持与原模型的竞争力,在自然图像上使用深度的一半,在几个下游组织病理学环境中,TWT匹配甚至改进了原基线.

articles.title: G^2RA-NET: Graph-based Cross-Slice Relation Modeling with Attention Gating for Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical image segmentation supports quantitative clinical analysis and computer-aided diagnosis. Recent methods for medical image segmentation have improved both local feature representation and volumetric context modeling. However, existing methods still strug- gle to efficiently model cross-slice relations in anisotropic volumet- ric images, limiting segmentation consistency and accuracy. This pa- per proposes G^2RA-Net, a medical image segmentation framework that combines graph-based cross-slice relation modeling with atten- tion gating. Graph-Based Slice Relationship Modeling (GSRM) cap- tures anatomical dependencies across consecutive slices by repre- senting each slice as a graph node and propagating semantic con- text through graph message passing. The Cross-Slice Attention Gate (CSAG) then selects relevant neighboring context and emphasizes target anatomical regions through attention-guided feature modula- tion. Experiments on brain MRI and abdominal CT datasets demon- strate that G^2RA-Net outperforms representative methods in seg- mentation accuracy and boundary quality. Ablation studies further validate the proposed design.

articles.title_zh: G^2RA-NET: 以图为基础的跨剪切关系模型, 医学图像分片注意
articles.content_zh: 医疗图像分解支持定量临床分析和计算机辅助诊断. 近期的医学图像分解方法既改进了局部特征表现,也改进了体积环境模型。 然而,现有的方法仍然是strug-gle,在异位体的体积-ric图像中高效地模拟交叉切片关系,限制了分解的一致性和准确性. 这个 pa- per 提出 G^2RA- Net,一个医学图像分解框架,将基于图的交叉切片关系模型与 atten- tion gating 结合. 基于图的切片关系模型(GSRM) 盖- 缝合解剖学的依附关系 跨连续切片,通过重写将每个切片作为图节点发送,并通过图信息传递来宣传语义化的文本. 交叉切片注意门(CSAG)然后选择相关的邻域上下文,并通过注意引导特征modula-tion强调目标解剖区域. 关于脑磁共振和腹部CT数据集的实验 恶魔 -- -- 标定G^2RA-Net在粘合精度和边界质量方面超过了代表性方法。 附带研究进一步验证了拟议的设计。

articles.title: PointEvent: Rethinking Event-based Tiny Object Detection via Serialized Motion Evidence Accumulation
articles.content: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and motion sensitivity for tiny UAV detection, yet distant targets generate sparse and fragmented events that are easily overwhelmed by clutter and ego-motion. Existing methods mainly rely on dense event representations or local sparse spatiotemporal modeling, resulting in redundant computation or fragmented modeling of motion continuity across distant asynchronous events. To address this limitation, we introduce serialized motion evidence accumulation, which treats motion continuity as an ordered evidence propagation process. Specifically, the same event stream is organized into locality-preserving spatiotemporal paths and chronology-preserving temporal paths through the latent complementary serializations. Based on this principle, we propose PointEvent, a lightweight event-wise state-space framework that alternates serialized scans across the complementary orders, progressively consolidating fragmented motion evidence beyond fixed local neighborhoods. A high-resolution event branch preserves fine-grained target responses, while compact context modulation suppresses interference. Experiments demonstrate that PointEvent achieves SOTA with the fewest parameters and fastest measured inference among the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent

articles.title_zh: 点事件:反思基于事件的小物体通过序列化运动证据检测积累
articles.content_zh: 事件摄像头为微小的无人驾驶飞行器探测提供了高时间分辨率和运动敏感性,然而遥远的目标却产生零星零散的事件,很容易被杂乱无章和自负运动所压倒. 现有方法主要依靠密集事件表示或局部稀疏的spatiotal模型,导致在遥远的同步事件之间对运动连续性进行冗余计算或零散模型化. 为解决这一局限性,我们采用了序列化运动证据积累,将运动连续性视为一个有秩序的证据传播过程。 具体地说,同一事件流是通过潜在的互补序列来组织成局部保留时序路径和编年史保留时序路径的。 基于这一原则,我们提出PointEvent, 一种轻量级事件状态-空间框架, 替代序列扫描到互补命令中, 高分辨率事件分支保存精细的纹理目标响应,而紧凑上下文调制则抑制干扰. 实验证明,PointEvent以比较方法中最少的参数和最快的测量推论实现SOTA. 代码:https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition
articles.content: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Historical ATR therefore continues to rely largely on compact CRNN line recognizers, which are visually grounded and trainable on modest data. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. We adapt PP-OCRv6, a recent compact text recognizer without strong language modeling, for historical line recognition and compare it with a conventional CRNN across generalized pretraining, domain-specific training, corpus-level fine-tuning, and manuscript-specific few-shot adaptation on multilingual Latin- and Arabic-script material. While PP-OCRv6 does not consistently outperform the baseline when trained from scratch, heterogeneous pretraining produces markedly better generalization. Comparisons with the Qwen3.5-based Medusa recognizer further show that fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 can outperform a large VLM tailored towards historical Latin-script HTR.

articles.title_zh: 免费午餐? 修改PP-OCRv6以用于历史文本识别
articles.content_zh: 尽管报告得分令人印象深刻,但大型视觉语言模型由于计算成本、依赖大规模预训和幻觉,在历史自动文本识别中的实际吸收有限。 因此,历史上的ATR仍然在很大程度上依赖紧凑的CRNN线识别器,这些识别器可视化地定位,可训练使用微小的数据. 轻量级的无复发识别器保证了具有CRNNs实际优势的较大模型的准确性,但尚未对历史写作进行全面评价. 我们调整了PP-OCRv6, 即最近一个没有强力语言模型的紧凑文本识别器, 用于历史线的识别, 虽然PP-OCRv6在从零开始受训时没有一贯地超过基线,但不同的预训明显能更好地概括。 与基于Quen3.5的美杜莎识别器的比较进一步表明,经过微调的PP-OCRv6可以超过针对历史拉丁语标注HTR定制的大型VLM.

articles.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
articles.content: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

articles.title_zh: Astronex-World 1.0:实时互动世界模型基金会
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍Astronex-World 1.0, 一个开放的可控视频世界模型基金会。 鉴于文本提示(text-to-video)或初始观察(image-to-video),该模型在帧对齐的相机轨迹,连续动作,以及一个浮雕标识符下预测未来的视觉状态,并接受插入到一个特定展开位置的文本事件. 该家族为全文本生成提供了双向模型,并为持久生成提供了具有块-causal关注和交叉块KV缓存的因果模型,两者都建立在Wan2.2-TI2V-5B之前. PROPE注入相机的内在和外显,而64维的动作流则调制每个变形器层. 五级训练路径开发双向相机和动作控制,将主干转换为阻塞-caus生成,衍射出几个步骤的学生,恢复混合域动态,并应用不对称的DMD/DMD2分布匹配. 该因果模型在24 fps生成832x480视频. 所有五个培训阶段都在两个NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU上运行,因果模型流在一个上实时运行. 它在WBench Navi和WBench Full上分别获得73.5分和70.0. 在Full上,这个5B型在13.6B LongCat-Video和14B Helios上方,在22B LTX-2.3的1点之内,在YUME 1.5以上,在NVIDIA A100 GPU上前从同一5B上进行后期训练. 保留的行动投入和产出接口允许在培训后进行体现智能和自主驾驶。

articles.title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GRF-Recon:全球雷田优化长序进料重建
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 3D重建为从图像序列进行场景模型化提供了高效的范式. 将这些模型放大到大单体情景,受到GPU内存足迹过多,局部几何学退化以及长期轨迹漂移的限制. 现有的基于块的优化战略提供了有限的几何限制,无法在扩展轨迹上保持全球一致性. 我们提出了一个统一的框架,用于从长长的单体序列中进行稳定和可伸缩的3D前向饲料重建。 我们的方法建立在粗细对细轨迹的配合上,加上轻量级几何前注射。 通过LORA的适应将单光度几何提示分解入向导主干线,提高了精细结构的深度精度,同时保持了推论效率。 我们引入了混合-重量的稀疏射线场优化,利用高频几何特征来引导局部点云的精细化,执行一致的机体间射线约束. 与先前的块法不同,这确立了强跨框几何耦合,同时保持可伸缩性. 最后,采用高效的轨迹缝合策略,结合射线-误差优化,明确减少累积漂移. 广泛的实验表明,与具有代表性的SLAM系统相比,我们的方法实现了具有竞争力的轨道精度,同时在大规模情景中保持全球一致的立体重建。

articles.title: AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models
articles.content: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AVTraces:在Omni模型中诊断视听时间原因
articles.content_zh: Omni模型可以描述视频内容,但他们能及时定位事件,维护事件顺序,判断视听同步吗? 我们引入了AVTrace(视听时间理性评估与能力评价),这是一个银质标准诊断套件,跨越起落架、同步、下一步预测、跨模式本地化、链条剖析和事件条件理解。 它包括34 114个培训实例和类别均衡发展,并分为3 500个和7 000个实例。 我们利用参考盲反应正常化,然后确定性评分,对5个开放的全米模型进行各自的输入配置评价。 所有五个现成系统在同步核查方面都低于试验分解0.556的多数标签基线,并在链剖析和事件条件的搁浅和理解方面获得低分。 开发设置的扰动在Qune3-Omni-30B中揭示了依赖任务对模式移除和视觉输入处理变化的敏感性,而不孤立其根本原因. 参数效率高的时间培训后,在几个基准度量标准上改进了Gemma4-E4B-it。 在三个外部图像基准上,任务衡量标准变化不大,包括一些退化,而教师强迫的模糊性则减少。 这些调查结果共同表明,语义参考文本重叠不应作为时间定位的代名词,AVTrace可以识别特定任务的弱点,同时为时间后训练提供测试床.

articles.title: QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning
articles.content: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: QCPruner:可视Token Pruning的查询条件人口覆盖
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中的高可视化负载激励了无培训的推算以减少后层计算,但在固定的预算下,推算必须保留与查询相关的证据,同时避免冗余. 现有方法对标志进行排序,使选定的子集多样化,或者在不使用共享的每个视觉查询工具来权衡视觉目标和候选代表的情况下优化覆盖面. 我们引入了QCPruner,它通过双边效用权重,使两个角色的查询成为条件. QCPruner使用关键词匹配的查询主机,将两个交叉模式的提示引信进入到效用中,并将其应用于视觉目标以及视效覆盖范围内的候选代表. 由此产生的非负式设施定位目标为单调和亚模块,保留标准(1-1/e)贪婪的保证,不需要模型培训或参数更新. 在整个LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NEXT、LLaVA-Video和Quen2.5-VL中,QCPruner在每一个报告符号预算中,在经过评价的完整系统运行方法中实现了最高的相对绩效。 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上的576个信使中的32个,它保留了96.1%的未刷孔性能,而最强评价基线则保留了93.9%。 在Quen2.5-VL-7B上的1296个令牌中的256个,相应的值为96.7%和92.5%.

articles.title: An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras
articles.content: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.

articles.title_zh: 事件摄像头的异质代表
articles.content_zh: 事件相机为机器人等实时视觉任务提供低纬度,高时间分辨率感知. 新颖的电路(即一个同步,独立的像素)使得这些优势得以实现,这也带来了新的算法挑战. 极速-无变色表示减轻了在慢运动下缺失的观测,在快动作下移动模糊,但大多数通过将事件转换成类似图像的表示来丢弃时间信息. 我们提出一组中活动受体场(SCARF),这是一种实时速度不变化的表示方式,既保护原始事件,同时又始终如一地处理快速运动,静止场景,以及独立移动的物体. SCARF在计算效率和代表质量方面都实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
articles.content: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

articles.title_zh: 装有隐蔽-智能机操纵工具的编码代理
articles.content_zh: 编码代理已经作为机器人操纵的有希望的范式出现:一个语言模型将机器人控制器写作一个程序,以这种方式建造的代理现在在没有机器人特定训练的情况下操作机器人. 然而,这一模式是否也是安全的,却没有被问及。 我们在安全限制下评估编码剂,每个任务将操纵目标与机器人不得触碰的障碍相配. 代理人追求目标,但在多数情况下却与障碍相撞,将完成任务作为唯一目标,同时忽视安全。 代理人对其痕迹中的障碍提出理由,而即刻就已经禁止触碰它,所以感知和指示都不是过错;错误在于规划,而所宣称的制约从来不成为优先. 通过将操纵分解成一个路由阶段和一个接触量丰富的瞬间,我们找到失败的来源. 沿途,该模型不能确定安全限制的优先顺序,对通关路线没有任何概念,一旦选定的路线变得不可行,也不可能重新规划。 在联系人时,它不知道联系执行受到同样的制约。 为了缩小这一差距,我们介绍了SafeHarness,它为模型配备了两个有障碍意识的装置,使其能够优先处理安全制约。 视障-视障路由规划将物体设为界框,并在上方取出候选路由作为路由点序列. 特工随后提前计划出一条路线,核实,必要时再作规划,后再执行. obstacle-aware 联系执行取而代之的是选择联系位置,以便联系人本身避免障碍. 安全到达 71.9%的任务成功率和87.5%的避免相撞率,分别比以前的SOTA高出6.5%和27.0%. 这些结果分别是2.3美元和1.5美元,即是同一代理商没有拉带的结果。

articles.title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
articles.content: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 嵌入式模型测量法
articles.content_zh: 嵌入空间定义语义相似性和距离的概念. 我们研究这些嵌入物是否反映了质量、距离、时间和体积的物理测量,这承认了一种独特的客观的语义等同概念和距离。 我们发现物理测量在嵌入空间中只有微弱的模型,相反可以观察到相当奇特的测量模式. 进一步的分析表明,物理测量的嵌入表示受到表面弦相似性的巨大影响,类似性的重新校正并不能大大改善对齐性.

articles.title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
articles.content: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

articles.title_zh: 在在线演讲中统一群体间托管模式
articles.content_zh: 针对社会群体的敌对言论能够使排斥正常化,为虐待辩护,并且助长两极分化和政治暴力的上升。 在网络言论中温和敌对言论的努力借鉴了社会和道德心理学以及政治学的基本理论。 然而,这些理论基本上是平行发展的,常常提出不同且有时相互矛盾的关于敌意如何发展的说法,很少在真实的论述中互相检验. 其结果是对敌对的言辞机制零零碎碎的理解,对它们在现实世界的言论中如何出现和彼此联系没有明确的认识。 在2024年美国总统选举期间,我们利用TikTok、Treal Social和Twitter/X的286万个帖子,在一个共同的经验框架内,以恢复更广泛的团体间敌对言论组织为模式,构建六个团体间敌对的基本理论 -- -- 边界建设、威胁建设、替罪羊、负面评价、非人性化和行动导向。 从结构上来说,我们发现边界建设和威胁建设是系统的基础;从时间上看,我们发现这些机制往往遵循常规命令:边界建设、减损和行动导向往往很早就出现;非人化和威胁建设后来出现;替罪羊。 这些理论框架实际上如何在论述中表现出来,跨越了社会科学传统的长期分歧,并提出了计算社会科学,为模拟超越单一标签检测的团体间敌对言辞提供了更明确的经验基础。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
articles.content: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

articles.title_zh: 关于编码代理设计的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 编码利用会塑造自主编码剂如何将模型能力转化为长视距软件-工程性能,然而现有工作通常会评价利用为单体系统,使得单个组件的有效性不明确. 为了能够进行组件层面的比较,我们用一种轻量级的编码工具来研究这个问题,该工具的执行循环是固定的,而三个组件是不同的:规划、行动空间和上下文管理。 在SWE-Bench验证和Terminal-Bench 2.1评价的四种模式中,我们评价了176个匹配的设置,涵盖5个背景管理战略、4个背景窗口预算以及有针对性的规划和行动空间。 我们发现:(1) 随着上下文窗口预算收紧,背景管理变得日益重要,其大部分好处来自防止上下文流失败。 (2) 在基于LLM的汇总之前安装基于规则的消除,在上下文管理战略中提供了最强的总体效率,而使可回收的滑动内容增加机械,而模型很少使用这种机械,而且不会产生准确性收益。 (3)规划从精准脚手架为弱型模型转向成本节约器为强型模型,精准度变化不大. (4) 预先界定的工具可以提高打击能力较弱的模型的性能,而打击能力模型则可以仅用一个打击界面有效操作,并实现成本低得多,特别是在以指挥线为中心的任务上。 轨迹级分析解释了这些影响:上下文管理扩展执行轨迹而不实质性改变代理行为,规划轨迹停止时的改变,动作空间改变写代码时的颗粒性. 这些结果为模型和预算认知的利用设计提供了依据,并为评估未来的利用组件提供了一个模块框架。

articles.title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
articles.content: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

articles.title_zh: JEPA-任何东西:学习不同世界的预测模型
articles.content_zh: 世界建模使情报能够预测后果,指导干预,并从互动中学习。 然而,预测模型仍然具有特定领域:一个共同的学习原则能否支持跨越根本不同的系统的世界模型? 我们介绍了JEPA-Anything,这是一个基于正向预测因素(OPF)的域不可知框架. 扩大联合嵌入式预测架构,OPF将潜在目标分解成互补因素,通过专用路径学习,并在共同的预测设计中重新组合. 我们评价JEPA—— 涉及七个领域的一切:视觉、生物学、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理领域和天气。 实验跨越表现学习,干预预测,离散通化,长视动态,包括10个匹配的动态任务,预测1000多个临床事件,100步分子跨4个系统展开. 对照对应的JEPA基线,JEPA-任何东西都改进了所有10项动态任务的报告衡量标准,并将干预庞的单干预预测误差减少了34.8%。 它在所有四个系统中的比较方法中实现了最低的单步和100步分子误差. 除预测外,一种因子命名的生物干预在细胞共育、病人衍生的有机体、肿瘤碎片和小鼠中得到了实验支持;潜在的轨道模式恢复了Keplerian缩放指数,配位坡度为 -1.4991。 这些成果支持不同世界的共同要素化预测原则,将世界模型与干预和实验性科学发现联系起来。 代码:https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-任何东西

articles.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 退休 OPD: 主动强化学习自退政策
articles.content_zh: 受过强化学习(RL)培训的多回合代理商每个轨迹都获得单一的分级奖赏,这激励了自我政策分级(OPD)向具有特殊任务技能的自师提供密集的符号级监督,让没有技能的学生将其内化. 然而,这种方法由于在代理任务中的两项发现而受到损害:光凭特权信息并不总是能使教师可靠,教师监督的好处取决于阶段。 因此,我们提议退休(自主退休),首先通过环境奖励,优化一名脱钩、技能条件好的教师,然后与RL和OPD联合培训一名无技能的学生。 RetireOPD没有遵循预先确定的蒸馏时间表,而是采用适应性退休:学生一旦其差异停止缩小,便自行放弃教师,并达到教师成功率的一个目标分数,之后仅通过RL就开始培训. 在整个Quen2.5型号从1.5B到7B, RetireOPD将ALFWorld的成功率比RL基线提高14.1%到18.8%,WebShop精度提高11.8%到19.0%,并在各种场合都超过了自己的技能条件教师.

articles.title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
articles.content: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

articles.title_zh: GPT模式中的伤害洗钱:性别歧视正在改变的证据,而不是在经过安全培训的几代人中减少
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型的安全评价依赖于报告不同代模型中危害分数下降的表面形式分类器。 我们提供证据表明,这种方法系统不完整:明确的歧视内容被改变而不是删除。 我们称之为\emph{ 清除伤害}。 在跨GPT-2至GPT-5的15个模式(开放AIGPT血统;三种人口状况)中,我们分析了45万个性别定向完成情况。 我们显示,在GPT-2妇女定向产出中普遍存在的性暴力集群被GPT-4所消失,而男性定向完成情况则获得了积极的代表权(护理、情感范围、盟友身份),而妇女定向完成情况并非如此。 该模式在GPT-5中最为明显:主题~5(1,997~documents)将乳腺癌作为男性权利辩论的框架,而在女性定向输出中则出现零等效集群. 三位独立分类者将此内容评为无毒. 感官在GPT-4评分反转:早期模型贬低女性;后来模型过错. 与男子相比,在GPT-4对齐边界上,妇女定向完成的课题多样性为36.%(W/M~美元=0.58美元,而GPT-2)为0.91美元。 与释放日期(+0.55美元,美元=0.34美元)有关的ARD说明性损害差异,而解毒不(++0.23美元,美元=42美元):毒性分数随着说明性损害的增加而下降。 我们正式将伤害洗钱作为三项标准测试,并提供适用于任何基因模型的三阶段检测协议。 在OpenAI GPT家族中,毒性分数的降低不足以代表减少伤害。

articles.title: dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: dQuen3.5:混合散射语言模型
articles.content_zh: 调整预先训练的自动递归(AR)模型是一种成本效率高的路线,可以适应扩散语言模型(DLM). 虽然几乎所有的这种改造都是从全心全意的变压器开始的,但AR模型化已经转向了混合结构,这些结构将注意力和RNN层相交. 这给适应造成障碍:与注意力不同,RNN在结构上是因果关系的,在双向化上是非三角性的. 尽管有这种不匹配,我们还是通过在0.8B,2B,4B,和9B的尺度上调整Quen3.5,从而产生dQuen3.5家族,来调查这种骨干是否能够成为有效的DLM. 我们发现混合骨干可以成为适应的高效起点:在全心全意的控制下,混合体在大约一半的符号中达到给定的训练损失. 纵观天平,dQuen3.5在任意顺序解码行为中类似全心DLM,在平行解码下表现强烈.

articles.title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
articles.content: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

articles.title_zh: 强制注意:语言模型 知道何时可以召回
articles.content_zh: 合理性和代理性的工作量日益需要高效率的长期推断。 然而,全心全意地解码读取了不断增长的历史,无论它对下一个预测有何好处。 我们显示,一个预先训练过的模型的解码状态 已经包含了预测这种好处的信息, 在全球阅读之前。 基于这一发现,我们引入了On-Demand Record(ODA),这是一种本地首个解码方法,它使用轻量级的召回头来有选择地引用全球注意力作为其在一代人时期的预期利益变化. 官方发展援助只培训召回头,使预先训练的重量保持不变,并提供了完整的历史KV缓存,供今后召回。 我们进一步在 vLLM 中执行 GPU 边有条件执行, 将减少的全局读化为实际解码速度, 以在长的上下文长度中充分注意。 跨越Quen和Gemma模型的实验,包括混合关注主干线,显示选择性召回恢复了当地关注下损失的大部分性能,同时大幅降低了全球读数. 这些调查结果支持了经过预先训练的模型指导自己获取所保留信息的长期推断。

articles.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
articles.content: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不要掩盖环境:观察监督改变代理人如何探索RL
articles.content_zh: 代理轨迹记录一个代理做什么 接下来会发生什么 然而,标准监督微调(SFT)只将损失适用于代理授权的动作符号,将环境观测作为上下文而不是预测目标。 我们问,这项公约是否为随后的强化学习提供了最好的初始化。 我们引入了ActObs,它也监督每个轨道上已经存在的观测标志. 虽然部署的代理人从不产生观测结果,但学习预测结果则鼓励政策在不增加数据、参数、序列符号或前行通行证的情况下模拟行动后果。 这些方法在SFT之后运行类似,但在GRPO之后运行不同. 在Qwen3-4B上, ActObs 的GRPO在每次评估的采样预算中都比起终端-Bench 2.0上的仅行动对应器实现更高的通过率@k. 在Qwen3-8B上,它用一些通过@1的可靠性来交换更高的通过@k(+3.4 pp at pass@16),并解决了比较不同的任务. 其优势扩大到了在Aider-polyglot上的跨域码编辑(Pass@1 at 4B),其任务在SFT和RL期间是看不见的. 行为 Obs在RL期间保留了较多的 en,同时需要较少的政策运动,使得最终的政策更接近于它的SFT初始化. 我们的分析将这一差异追溯到SFT:动作和观测梯度迅速变成正交,而只行动训练则留下了巨大的剩余观测梯度并降解了基模型下的环境预测. 联合监督可以防止这种片面的专业化,保留后果预测并准备下游勘探的政策.

articles.title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
articles.content:
This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 总结比斯: 在大语言模型中将目标投射成有线模式标签的定向折叠 -- -- 概念框架和注册测试协议
articles.content_zh:
本文介绍并操作了归纳偏好:一种拟议的系统倾向,即大型语言模型(LLMS)将叙述意义作为抽象的概括标签来表示,而不是作为产生它的可重建的推断结构来表示. 在布卢特理论中,叙事效应是沿着一个被告知的轴心来理论的:在被告知模式中,情感和信息内容被明确宣布,需要很少的读者重建;在显示模式中,内容被压制在表面,必须从物理提示和间接(客观预测)来重建. Shown模式是学说所设计用来测量的较高负载条件.
索赔是,LLMs沿着这一轴向具体方向失败。 总结偏好被假设为在两种制度下运作:(一) 基因制度,在这种制度下,一个模型要求通过目标预测(Objective Project)来产生一种情绪,而代之以宣布这种情绪;(二) 一个评价制度,在这种制度下,一个模型判断叙事质量的回报,即明码的明晰度和未发现的显示模式的压制。 评估制度的影响更大,因为法学硕士越来越多地担任法官和奖励模式,对既定模式的定向偏好会给平面申报带来不利于改宗的选择压力。
本报告并不声称偏见得到证实。 它界定了构造,将其定位于LLM-as-judge的偏差,重新阅读了完成的独立可靠性研究,作为与其一致的方向证据,并预先登记了带有决定规则的两套制度测试,据此该构造将被放弃。

articles.title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HerHealthEval:评价多种语言和登记——对妇女健康交流的敏感理解
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在保健沟通中越来越多地被使用,然而大多数评价都强调反应质量,同时假设用户的关切得到了正确的解释. 我们介绍了HerHealthEval,这是一个多语种理解妇女健康交流的控制性评价框架。 对于每个临床病例,HerHealthEval提供英语,法语和现代标准阿拉伯语的相匹配版本,使用六种交流形式:犬科,临床,外行,间接或被套住,情感上关心,以及刻意不够精确. 前五个表格表达了同样的基本关切并保留了同样的临床信息,而规格不足的表格故意省略了相关细节,以检验模型是否承认需要澄清。 我们评价一个多语种教学模型和QLORA调整过的关于相关分类、风险校正、澄清行为、解析合规性和跨形式一致性的变体。 结果显示,总的准确性和一致性可以掩盖与安全有关的失败。 在语言不对称风险监督下,法语和阿拉伯语的多语种适应模式达到0.994次。 使用源出物,语言变异性风险标签进行有控制的再适应,使去向不足的风险分别降低到0.572和0.558. 这些调查结果表明,要进行强有力的多语种保健评价,就必须对登记册的变异性、不确定性的处理以及适应标签的来源和变化情况进行明确的测试。

articles.title: PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations
articles.content: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PAA: 概率化的艾伦代数:艾伦间关系的基因和完全概率扩展
articles.content_zh: 艾伦的间隔代数是时间关系的一个质的微积分,但其十三个碱基关系是精准地超越精确间隔边界的上游. 这对于来自语言,感知,数据库,或不确定历史的时间信息来说是不够的,在这些历史中,时间,持续时间,边界都是不确定的,而"刚刚之前"或"勉强期间"等表达方式具有分级意义. 我们开发出概率化的艾伦代数(PAA):一种基因和完整的扩展,在这个扩展中,关系概率来源于间隔边界的分布,而不是被分配为分数. 时间点为高斯;间隔有高斯中点和短-高斯持续时间. 每一种关系都是一个常见概率空间中的边界排序的上游:点点关系会缩小为出错函数,点点间和间隔间关系会与由线性不平等所引发的多变量高斯或直径概率关系. 联系关系(meets, starts, finishers, equals)通过宽容带获得积极措施,在单一宽容下,13个关系形成真正的分治,随着宽容的消失而恢复了舒缓的艾伦. 构造来源于艾伦的分类学,而不是假设:粗糙的上游,如优先,重叠,和封存是叶子的结合,其概率是叶子总和,随着间隔倒塌到点上,13个关系减少为5个再减少为3个,这种分层得到保留. 每一种关系会以CIDOC CRM的精神进一步分解为具有关联感的时间原始. 代数为尺度-变量并分出分级的表达方式,如"短前"与接触关系. 所有结果均被Monte-Carlo验证并被运出,作为已测试的开放式Python包.

articles.title: UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising
articles.content: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单一政策:基因搜索广告的统一目标特定政策
articles.content_zh: 搜索广告将用户意图与商业内容相连接,并在平台货币化中起关键作用. 最近的系统通常将预先训练的基因模型与eCPM等单一的商业奖励相配合,或使用天真的奖励组合来进行初步的多目标配对. 然而,理想的搜索广告系统必须共同说明不同的目标,包括相关性、点击倾向和商业价值,以平衡用户的经验和商业价值,同时减轻梯度竞争造成的全球不良业绩。 我们提议统一政策,这是一个客观的多政策协调框架。 UniPolicy将目标专用前缀符号,稀疏的MOE-LORA路由,以及目标专用的剩余FFN在共享主干内分级分解参数,为不同的业务目标提供有区别的参数和政策表达空间. 它进一步构建了多阶段行为反馈的对等偏好,补充了被曝光但未点击的样本中的相对偏好信息,加强了被点击候选人在生成分布中的相对优势. 推论, " 统一政策 " 支持平行的、符合业务需要的多政策束搜索,在固定检索预算下灵活分配不同目标的候选人配额。 大规模线下实验显示,UniPolicy在保持检索质量、优于单目标强化学习和天真奖励基准的同时,在多个度量衡方面提供平衡的改进。 在真实搜索广告系统的7天在线A/B测试中,UniPolicy将CTR改进了0.71%,RPS改进了1.58%,广告收入则提高了1.32%,同时保持了稳定的服务休息状态.

articles.title: Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents
articles.content: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 纪事: LLM 代理的回转测试切入点回放
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型响应是非定型的,因此LLM代理的失败很难被复制:失败取决于不能比特地复制的推论,取决于读取变化状态的工具,以及重运行时很少重复的多步道. 记录和回放使得运行可再出,但现有的代理工具记录运行只是为了追踪或分分出它们,而不是测试一个对照它们的代码更改. 我们介绍"纪事",它记录一个代理以非决定性边界运行作为不可改变的信封,并从记录中重放. 其中心操作,切分重放,服务于从记录中选择的边界子集,并用新代码执行互补子集活性,将所记录的事件变为在连续集成中运行的回归测试. 在6个记录有模拟模型边界的失败基准上,记录每次过境增加23 μs(假设为300ms模型呼叫的0.008%),全面重放0个模型呼叫,并跨出20个重复,切入点测试在错误代码上失败并传递所有6起事故的小心和良性改变. 在对被保护工具的突变研究中,切点测试捕获了让记录的不安全行动穿过的每一个变种人,而利用同样的断言来固定每个边界的基线则捕获了无. 《纪事》和基准可在https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle上公开查阅。

articles.title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
articles.content: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 将信息私密化对政策自我扭曲有什么补充?
articles.content_zh: 政策上的自我消化(OPSD)让一个语言模型从冷冻的本体中学习,从中看到一个答案或有效的解决方案. 给老师这个额外的信息 似乎可以让学生多学点, 但除了蒸馏本身,它能增加多少? 为了分离这个贡献,我们构建了AMPLE-Math,一个可重复使用的由5,319个数学问题组成的套件,其中6个推理观点具有相同的答案,并且将每个观点与匹配的无参考分解相比较. 由于一名有思维能力的教师监督直接反应的推出,无参考的蒸馏法占了Qwen3-1.7B在有思维能力的评价下,无论是在域内还是在外部基准上的改进。 在Quen语中,额外参考效益的证据不多,对于抛光的溶液最有力,而完整的痕迹在第50步SmolLM3-3B中增加了两个百分点。 这些福利取决于学生是否接受培训。 在同一检查站,用长期思维驱动的推出取代短时间的直接反应推出,将收益变成两个家庭的损失,而问题、参考和评价保持不变。 Quen的教师简介和相应的损失干预进一步表明,改变象征性监管可以使学生的行为基本保持不变。 这些调查结果合在一起表明,OPSD可以通过直接反应和启发思考的推论共享的参数来改进对现有推理能力的获取. 特权引用的价值在于它为这种跨模式的传输增加了什么,而不是它揭示出多少解决方案.

articles.title: WiC is Not WSD: A Study on LLMs and Lexical Ambiguity Resolution
articles.content: Word-in-Context (WiC) remains challenging for language models, despite recent progress on lexical-semantic tasks. We hypothesise that this difficulty arises not only from comparing two contextual uses of a word, but also from the absence of an explicit sense inventory that specifies the relevant level of semantic granularity. We evaluate open LLMs on WiC and traditional Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) under similar settings. We find that providing candidate senses, similar to what is done in traditional WSD, improves WiC performance in all settings. In general, explicit sense information helps models make more consistent and targeted judgements. Human evaluation further shows that many apparent WiC errors reflect label ambiguity or mismatches between model and annotator sense boundaries rather than simple failures of lexical understanding. In particular, results show that LLMs overthink the sense distinction often leading to errors based on overly fine-grained distinctions.

articles.title_zh: WIC不是WSD:关于LLMs和Lexical 模糊分辨率的研究
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在语法语义任务方面取得了进展,但语言模式仍然面临挑战。 我们假设,这一困难不仅来自比较一个单词的两个上下文用途,而且也来自缺乏一个明确意义上的目录,其中具体规定了语义颗粒性的相关水平. 我们评价关于WIC的开放式LLMs和在类似环境下的传统Word Sense Division(WSD). 我们发现,提供候选感官,类似于传统WSD中的做法,可以提高WIC在所有环境中的性能. 一般而言,明确意义的信息有助于模型作出更加一致和有针对性的判断. 人类评价进一步表明,许多显然存在 WIC出错反映了模型与注释者感知边界之间的标签模糊或不匹配,而不是简单的词汇理解失败. 特别是,结果表明,法学硕士课程过多地思考了感官区分,往往导致基于过于细微的区分的错误。

articles.title: SAFARI: An Industrial Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for safety-critical engineering, yet their reliability in regulated functional-safety workflows remains underexplored. We introduce SAFARI (Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference), the first industrial benchmark for LLM-assisted automotive Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) under ISO 26262. It contains 3,000 de-identified industrial HARA cases and evaluates two coupled tasks: open-ended hazard analysis and standards-grounded risk assessment. To evaluate open-ended HARA artifacts, we propose the first reference-anchored LLM-as-a-judge protocol with high expert correlation. Experiments with nine frontier LLMs show that models often produce plausible hazard narratives but remain weak at ISO 26262 risk classification, with the best ASIL macro-F1 reaching only 0.261. Chain-of-Thought prompting provides limited benefit and often degrades categorical risk assessment. Error analysis further localizes major failures to scenario-critical context omissions during hazard generation and to controllability misjudgments during risk assessment, indicating where expert oversight should be concentrated. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/xixi47520-hash/HARA.

articles.title_zh: SAFARI: LLM-辅助危害分析和风险评估的工业基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于安全关键工程,但是它们在受管制的功能-安全工作流程中的可靠性仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们介绍了安全-智能功能汽车风险推论,这是ISO 26262规定的LLM辅助汽车危险分析和风险评估的第一个工业基准。 其中包括3 000起已查明的工业危险物质评估案例,并评估两项相关任务:无限制危险分析和基于标准的风险评估。 为了评价不限成员名额的阿拉伯原子能协会的文物,我们提议采用第一个具有高度专家相关性的参考参考LLM-as-a-judge协议。 与9个前沿LLMs的实验表明,模型往往产生可信的危险说明,但在ISO 26262风险分类中仍然很弱,最好的ASIL宏-F1只达到0.261. 启发思考的链提供了有限的好处,往往会降低绝对的风险评估。 错误分析进一步将风险产生时发生情景关键背景遗漏和风险评估期间发生可控性误判的重大故障本地化,指出专家监督应集中在何处。 该数据集可从https://github.com/xxi47520-hash/HARA上获取.

articles.title: Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies
articles.content: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT.

articles.title_zh: 指导指南:使动态心理咨询与认知行为治疗战略保持一致
articles.content_zh: 近期在大语言模式上的进步使心理咨询领域发生了革命性的变化,特别是在认知行为治疗(CBT)方面. 虽然CBT的成功很大程度上依赖于基于客户实时精神状态的动态决策,但这一方面在目前的研究中经常被忽略,限制了灵活性和治疗结果. 在本文中,我们介绍了StratCBT,这是一个专门为与CBT战略进行心理咨询对话而设计的数据集,由9,688个课和大约256K个演讲组成,每个辅导员的反应与8个不同战略之一一致。 StratCBT的建立涉及根据客户的负面想法建立模型,并通过自我聊天产生高质量的咨询谈话,将现实的课会作为指导,从而大大地超越了一般咨询和CBT特定技能中的现有数据集. 我们进行了广泛的试验,以证明战略协调一代的有效性,并评价其向LLM模拟客户提供专业和有效咨询的功效,以反映现实世界的情况。 数据集可从https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT上获取.

articles.title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
articles.content: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 语言模型组在重现人类对推理任务的审议时,过分夸大共识.
articles.content_zh: 完全一致的比率往往被视为集体认知的指标,但取决于参与和最终状态如何运作。 我们重新播放了100个被搁置的人类瓦森团体,配有匹配的大型语言模型(LLM)代理团体,为每个参与者的预讨论回答和评分代理人和同一代码的人播下一个信仰障碍代理人. 在整个人类评分定义中,估计从24.0%到57.0%不等;大约五分之一的参与者从未公布,而代理人几乎总是公布。 在两项失明后敏感性分析中,代理组仍然比较一致:以提交为基础的比较(n=98)得出的聊天和推理模式差距为34.0%和43.9%;参与对比(n=45)得出的差距为34.1%和44.4个百分点。 这些互补路线减少了不同的测量不对称现象,但在0.5个百分点范围内趋于一致。 差距持续存在,没有及早停止,在重新调整方法下,消除了令人难忘的答案;推理-模式小组随后几乎一致同意,大多是错误的答案。 模拟共识没有跟踪集体准确性,信仰不安的代理人团体是这一背景下人类群体结果分布的偏颇估计者. 这些分析为评估人类审议结果的模拟组估计提供了明确的评分依据。

articles.title: An Analysis of Training-Free Self-Reported Confidence in Language Models
articles.content: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 分析无培训的自报语文模式信心
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型可以报告数字信心和生成的内容,但目前还不清楚这份报告是否不止是校准的花言巧语. 我们分析三个没有训练的信号:信心用答案口头表示,后Hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$,以及另外三代人就同一个100个TriviaQA问题为两个模范家庭达成协议. 直接口语化是一个令人惊讶的有力基线:在审计基准出错后,它达到了AUROC 0.956和0.937的正确性预测. 三样协议大大弱了(0.765和0.790),有口服自信的固定插值在统计学上没有可靠的好处. 一个模型的9个出错中的4个和另一个模型的8个出错中的2个得到了一致的样本支持,表明自相矛盾可以扩大共同的误解. 重新激发对相同固定答案的信心,以等同的方式提示平均将分数从0.043分改为0.084分,并在0.8分的门槛上翻出4-Q至9-Q分决定. 对100起印有信任标记的传记性索赔进行探索性审计,进一步发现,在得到支持和相互矛盾的索赔之间,信任差距不大。 这些结果认为,有用的自我报告对诱发、相关错误和基准噪音仍然敏感。

articles.title: Relational Attention for Data-Efficient Language Modeling
articles.content: We present Relational BabyLM, a system submission to the BabyLM 2026 challenge that combines two cognitively motivated inductive biases in a single decoder-only Transformer. Architecturally, we replace standard self-attention with a Dual Attention Transformer (DAT), which separates the routing of object-level ("sensory") lexical features from structural/relational information (Altabaa and Lafferty, 2025; Altabaa et al., 2024; Webb et al., 2024; Kerg et al., 2022; Webb et al., 2021). Relational attention (RA) disentangled from self-attention greatly increases data efficiency and out-of-training-sample generalization on purely relational tasks, but language modeling requires object-level and relational information to be integrated as well as disentangled, and RA-based LMs have remained largely unexplored. BabyLM's data-constrained training and comprehensive evaluation is an ideal testing ground for whether that data efficiency transfers. As a training intervention, we add a Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat; Teoh et al. 2026) objective that encourages hidden states to compress history incrementally into a dense belief state. Architecture is the dominant factor for structural linguistic generalization; the objective is secondary but still significant. DAT's three relational attention types (full RA vs. the simpler RCA and DisRCA variants) are largely interchangeable at 10M words; full RA pulls ahead at 100M. We also introduce a novel symbol-retrieval mechanism (RoPE-based, as opposed to learned, relative symbols) that matches learned symbol libraries while adding no parameters. On the strict (100M-word) track, our best model ranks 6th of 55 overall and 3rd of 55 on the leaderboard's NLP-task subset at the time of writing; our two strongest models outperform the GPT-2 baseline on most benchmarks, with one attaining the highest EWoK score among strict-track entries.

articles.title_zh: 对数据有效语言建模的关联关注
articles.content_zh: 我们提出"关系宝贝LM"(Relational BabyLM),这是系统向"BabyLM"2026挑战的呈递,将两个认知动机的诱导偏差结合在一个单一的解码器唯一的变形器中. 在建筑学上,我们用一款"双重注意"变形器(DAT)来取代标准自觉,它把对象级("感官")的词典特征与结构/关系信息区分开来(Altabaa and Lafferty,2025;Altabaa等,2024;Webb等,2024;Kerg等,2022;Webb等,2021). 关系关注(RA)从自我关注中分解出来,大大提高了数据效率和对纯关系任务的培训外样本的概括性,但语言建模需要将对象级别和关系信息整合并分解,基于RA的LM仍然基本没有被探索. BabyLM数据受限培训和综合评价是数据效率是否转移的理想测试地. 作为培训干预措施,我们增加了一个 " 下层物质预测 " (NextLat;Teoh等,2026年)目标,鼓励隐蔽国家逐步将历史压缩成密集的信仰状态。 建筑是结构语言通俗化的主导因素;目标是次要的,但仍然重要. DAT的三种关系关注类型(full RA vs. 更简单的RCA和DisRCA变体)在10M单词上基本可以互换;full RA在100M上拉出前去. 我们还引入了一种新颖的符号检索机制(基于ROPE,与所学的相对符号不同),与所学的符号库相匹配而未添加参数. 在严格的(100M-word)赛道上,我们的最佳模式在写作时排在了主板的NLP-任务子集的第6位(总排名55)和第3位;我们两个最强的模型在大多数基准上都超过了GPT-2基准,其中有一个在严格赛道条目中达到了EWOK最高分.

articles.title: Model-Agnostic and Language-Agnostic Voice Pipeline Improvement for the Agriculture Domain
articles.content:
FarmerChat is Digital Green's AI-powered agricultural advisory assistant for smallholder farmers, who access it in their own language through text, voice, or photographs. Voice is a critical channel for this population, yet field-recorded speech is challenging for general-purpose automatic speech recognition (ASR) because recordings frequently contain machinery noise, background media, competing speakers, and domain-specific agricultural vocabulary. These conditions disproportionately affect crop, pest, chemical, and quantity terms that carry the meaning of a farmer's query.
  We present a modular, model-agnostic pipeline for improving ASR quality in FarmerChat without fine-tuning or replacing the underlying ASR model. The pipeline combines gated audio enhancement, speaker diarization and target-speaker selection, ASR, domain-aware correction using a weighted agricultural lexicon, and a quality gate for detecting unreliable transcripts. Only the diarization stage is fine-tuned; all other stages use off-the-shelf models behind common interfaces.
  We evaluate the pipeline on human-annotated FarmerChat recordings in Hindi, Telugu, and Odia using word error rate (WER) and a domain-weighted error rate that gives greater importance to agricultural terminology. The largest improvements occur on multi-speaker recordings, where target-speaker selection prevents competing speech from entering the transcript. Across the full corpus, the pipeline reduces WER by 16-23% relative on three cloud ASR models and by 5% on an on-device model. On multi-speaker recordings, the reductions are 32-42% for the cloud models and 16% for the on-device model. All reported reductions are statistically significant. These results show that targeted preprocessing, speaker selection, and domain-aware post-processing can substantially improve agricultural speech transcription while preserving the underlying ASR model.
