articles.title_zh: 农业领域模式-不可知和语言-不可知语音管道改进
articles.content_zh:
FarmerChat是Digital Green为小农提供人工智能的农业咨询助理,他们通过文字,语音或相片以自己的语言访问. 而现场录制的演讲对于通用自动语音识别(ASR)来说是挑战, 因为录音经常包含机械噪音、背景媒体、竞相演讲者以及特定领域的农业词汇。 这些条件对作物、害虫、化学和数量等具有农民查询含义的术语的影响格外严重。
我们提出了一个模块化、模型化、不可知性管道,用于改善FarmerChat的ASR质量,而无需微调或取代基本的ASR模型。 管道结合了有门的音频增强,扬声器的分化和目标语选择,ASR,使用加权农业词汇的域-感知校正,以及检测不可靠的文字记录的质量门. 只有平分相位相被微调;其他所有相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
我们用文字误差率(WER)和域加权误差率来评价印地语、泰卢固语和奥迪亚语的人文附加说明的FarmerChat录音管道, 最大的改进发生在多语种录音上,因为选择目标语种阻止了相竞的语音输入记录. 整个输油管在3个云ASR模型上将WER减少16-23%,在一台探测器模型上则减少5%。 在多语种录音中,云型机车的减速率为32-42%,而上机型机车的减速率为16%. 所有报告的削减在统计学上都具有重大意义。 这些结果表明,有针对性的预处理、演讲者选择和对域名认识的后处理可以大幅度地改进农业语音记录,同时保留基本的ASR模式。

articles.title: Edustories: A Collection of Real-world Case Studies from Classroom Practices
articles.content: Despite the widely recognized potential of AI in education, most prior work has focused on individualized student assistance. In contrast, the majority of educational practice worldwide still takes place in collective classroom settings. To enable researchers to study AI assistance in collective teaching, we introduce Edustories, a dataset of 1,492 teacher-written case studies describing real elementary and high-school classroom situations involving challenging student behavior, pedagogical interventions, and their outcomes. Among many other applications, Edustories enables evaluating LLMs' ability to predict the success of teacher interventions, crucial for providing practicing teachers with useful feedback. Comparing the latest models from four language-model families against expert assessments, we find that current models fall short of human expertise in predicting classroom outcomes; the strongest models reach 58% accuracy compared to 64% of human experts. This gap highlights both the limitations and the emerging potential of AI as assistants for practicing teachers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 故事:课堂做法中真实世界案例研究汇编
articles.content_zh: 尽管大赦国际在教育方面有着被广泛承认的潜力,但以前的大部分工作都侧重于个性化的学生援助。 相反,全世界大多数教育实践仍然在集体课堂环境中进行。 为了使研究人员能够研究AI在集体教学方面的协助,我们引入了Edustories,这是一个由1,492名教师撰写的个案研究数据集,其中描述了涉及挑战学生行为、教学干预及其结果的实际中小学课堂情况。 在许多其他应用中,Edustories使LLMS能够评价教师干预成功的能力,这对于向执业教师提供有用的反馈至关重要. 对比四个语言模型家庭的最新模型与专家评估,我们发现,目前的模型在预测课堂结果方面没有达到人类专业知识;最强模型的精确度达到了58%,而人类专家的精确度为64%。 这一差距突出了大赦国际作为执业教师助理的局限性和新出现的潜力。

articles.title: Stress-testing Alignment Midtraining
articles.content:
When aligning frontier models through post-training techniques, it is not possible to directly demonstrate all of the behaviours we want a model to exhibit in all possible deployment environments; our model must generalise outside of the post-training distribution. One proposed solution is alignment midtraining (AMT), which continues pretraining on large volumes of alignment-relevant documents to encourage generalisation in later stages of training.
  Despite the prominence of AMT as an alignment approach, there is limited public evidence for its effectiveness. To resolve this, we identify several assumptions around midtraining and evaluate them across scale: up to 110 billion-parameter models and 1 billion midtraining tokens. For instance, we study a scenario where post-training data is ambiguous between two possible motivations. We find that midtraining can steer the model's motivation in simple versions of this setting. However, the presence of a tiny fraction of finetuning data which suggests a competing motivation erases the effects of AMT. We also study scenarios in which we want an AI to follow a number of rules, but only demonstrate a subset of them. We find that demonstrations must be present either in midtraining or post-training datasets for these rules to be robustly learned.
  Based on these and other findings, we do not believe that there is sufficient public evidence for us to confidently state that midtraining can address the core difficulties inherent in aligning powerful AI systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 压力测试调整中级培训
articles.content_zh:
在通过培训后技术调整前沿模型时,不可能直接展示我们希望一个模型在所有可能的部署环境中展示的所有行为;我们的模型必须在培训后分布之外通用。 一个拟议解决办法是调整中期培训(AMT),它继续就大量与调整有关的文件进行预先培训,以鼓励在培训的后期阶段普及。
尽管AMT作为一种协调方法具有显著地位,但对其有效性的公开证据有限。 为了解决这一问题,我们确定了几个关于中级培训的假设,并进行了大规模的评估:多达1 100亿参数模型和10亿个中级培训标志。 例如,我们研究了两种可能动机之间培训后数据模糊不清的情况。 我们发现,中训可以引导模型的动机 以简单的版本的这种设置。 然而,微调数据的一小部分表明存在相互竞争的动机,从而消除了AMT的影响。 我们还研究了我们希望AI遵循一些规则的情景,但只展示其中的一部分. 我们认为,为了大力学习这些规则,必须在中级培训或培训后数据集中进行示范。
基于这些和其他调查结果,我们并不认为有足够的公开证据使我们有信心地说,中级培训可以解决调整强大的AI系统所固有的核心困难。

articles.title: Xeno-Interpretability: Investigating the Alien Minds of LLMs
articles.content: Large language models are usually interpreted through concepts that humans already possess: truthfulness, refusal, deception, personality, harmfulness, and related categories. This paper asks whether models may also represent and use distinctions for which no adequate human concept exists. We call such internal structures xeno-representations, and their study xeno-interpretability. We distinguish the human-interpretable semantic space from the xeno-semantic space: the region of model-native representations for which no adequate human conceptual counterpart is available. We show that the space of possible internal distinctions in an LLM is substantially larger than the space available through finite human descriptions. We then separate experimental identification from semantic interpretation: an internal representation may be reproducibly located, geometrically characterized, causally manipulated, and linked to downstream behaviour even when its semantic content cannot be adequately expressed in human terms. On this basis, we sketch an empirical programme to identify xeno-representations. We finally examine the implications for AI safety and multi-agent systems, where model-native representations may propagate and stabilize across interacting agents while remaining only partially visible through human-readable communication. Xeno-interpretability therefore shifts the aim of interpretability from finding human concepts inside models toward discovering and characterizing the representational structures that are native to the models themselves and might affect their behaviour in unpredictable ways.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Xeno-可解释性:调查LLMS的异形思维
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型通常通过人类已经拥有的概念来解释:真实性,拒绝,欺骗,个性,有害性等相关类别. 本文询问模型是否也能够代表和使用没有适当人类概念的区别。 我们称这种内部结构为xeno代表,它们的研究为xeno解释. 我们把人的解释性语义空间与xeno语义空间区分开来:即没有足够人的概念对应物的模型-内在表述区域. 我们显示,在LLM中可能存在内部区别的空间大大大于通过有限的人类描述可以获得的空间。 然后,我们将实验性识别与语义解释区分开来:内部代表可能重新出现定位,几何特征,因果被操纵,与下游行为相关联,即使其语义内容不能用人文表达. 在此基础上,我们勾画出一个经验方案,以确定Xeno代表。 最后,我们研究了人工智能安全和多代理系统的影响,即模型内涵可能传播和稳定相互作用的物剂,而仅通过人能读取的通信部分可见。 因此,Xeno-可解释性将可解释性的目标从在模型内找到人类概念转向发现和定性原生的代表结构,而这种结构可能以不可预测的方式影响模型本身。

articles.title: Schema-Anchored Latent Reasoning for Semantic Parsing-Based Knowledge Base Question Answering
articles.content: Semantic parsing (SP)-based knowledge base question answering aims to answer natural language questions by generating executable logical forms (LFs) over knowledge bases (KBs). When applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to this task, a key challenge over large, heterogeneous KBs is selecting question-related schema elements (i.e., relations and classes) and composing them into complex LFs. Recent LLM-based methods often make early discrete commitments to schema elements during intermediate reasoning, allowing incorrect intermediate schema decisions to propagate and finally result in incorrect LFs. To overcome this limitation, we propose SALR, a schema-anchored latent reasoning method for LF construction. It performs multi-step reasoning by generating continuous thoughts in the model's hidden states, thereby delaying the explicit commitment to LF decisions. To ground this latent reasoning process in the corresponding KB schema, SALR aligns continuous thoughts with a codebook of KB schema elements through an alignment objective supervised by schema traces deterministically derived from gold LFs. It then incorporates the aligned schema codes into inputs for subsequent reasoning steps. This schema-mediated feedback guides LF generation without requiring the model to emit an explicit textual reasoning trajectory. Experiments on GrailQA and WebQSP show that SALR achieves consistent overall gains over strong baselines. Notably, on compositional questions from GrailQA, SALR outperforms TIARA, a strong SP-based baseline, by 2.86 F1 points. Further analyses show that schema-mediated feedback affects LF generation and that schema information is recoverable from the latent states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Schema-Anchored 语义解析知识的后期原因 基础问答
articles.content_zh: 语义解析(SP)基于知识库的问题解答旨在通过生成可执行的逻辑表(LFs)来回答自然语言的问题,而不是知识库(KBs). 在应用大语言模型(LLMs)来完成这项任务时,对于大而多样的KB来说,一个关键的挑战就是选择与问题相关的计划要素(即关系和类)并将其组合成复杂的LF. 最近基于LLM的方法常常在中间推理时对计划要素作出早期的离散承诺,允许错误的中间计划决定被传播,最终导致不正确的LF. 为了克服这一局限性,我们提议使用SALR,一种用于LF结构的有计划的潜在推理方法。 它通过在模型的隐藏状态下产生持续的思想来进行多步骤的推理,从而推迟对LF决定的明确承诺. 为了将这种潜在的推理过程建立在相应的KB计划之上,SALR通过一个由从黄金低地得到的测定分量的Schema分量所监督的校正目标,将持续的思想与KB计划元素的编码本相配合。 然后,它把一致的计划代码纳入随后的推理步骤。 这种由计程介导的反馈指导了LF生成,而不需要模型发出明确的文字推理轨迹. 在"圣杯QA"和"WebQSP"上的实验表明,SALR在强基线上取得了一致的整体收益. 值得注意的是,在来自圣杯QA的构成问题上,SALR的绩效比以SP为基础的强基线TIARA高出2.86 F1分. 进一步的分析表明,以计划为媒介的反馈影响LF的生成,而计划信息可以从潜在状态中恢复。

articles.title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals
articles.content: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 要复制或不复制:通过 Intrinsic 模型信号控制光谱解码
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码(SD)大大地加快了大语言模型(LLM)推论,然而,现有的方法在两种起草策略之间面临根本取舍:神经起草和上下文复制. 神经发作(如EAGLE3)在不同的文本设置中提供强劲的性能,而以复制为基础的方法则通过更快生成考生并利用长时间的重复时间来进行近乎完美的猜测,在复制密集型制度中实现更高的速度. 我们分析现有的以拷贝为基础的方法,发现它们容易发生意外重复,因为地表平面正克重叠不能反映复制的结构意图,导致虚假的正率触发,最终降低吞吐量. 我们引入了SwitchSD,一个将复制作为LLM潜在控制信号的适应性框架. SwitchSD通过在目标模型的内部表示上训练轻量级探测器,以高精度(AUC > 0.99)识别出真正的复制意向. 这使得系统能够在神经起草(如EAGLE)和上下文复制之间动态切换. 我们的Llama和Quen家庭的结果显示,超过EAGLE3等最新基线的吞吐量增长高达15%,实际上将从吵闹的heuristic复制成有原则的、具有示范意识的解码制度。

articles.title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
articles.content: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 考虑一下 重排前: 文本重排的多视角证据和合理整合
articles.content_zh: 基于理性的重排与"大语言模型"(LLMs)在文本排位上表现出了有希望的改进. 然而,目前的方法主要依靠单一的推理轨迹,导致的排名容易被推理错误所影响,在模拟文件相关性所依据的多方面信号时必然受到限制。 为了解决这一难题,我们提议提出MERIT-Rank(多视角证据和合理整合,以便重新排列文本),这个框架可以模拟互补推理轨迹,提高重新排列的稳健性。 MERIT-Rank 制定了多轨理性空间(MTRS),从多个角度评价查询-文档相关性,并引入了将这些推理路径整合为统一排序决定的联合重新排序. 我们进一步发展进步排名政策优化(PRPO),这是一个渐进式培训框架,稳定推理轨迹,同时通过分阶段优化目标不断提高排名质量. 关于推理密集型和传统检索基准的实验表明,MERIT-Rank在竞争基线上一贯取得优于业绩。 在BRIGHT上,4B模型显著地超过了大多数7B甚至32B的再排名.

articles.title: Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model
articles.content: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: IBM Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC ASR模型的设计
articles.content_zh: 我们描述了Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC的架构、培训方法和推论速度,这是一种4.7亿参数编码器唯一的模型,具有极佳的速度精确度取舍。 该建筑采用Conformer区块内金字塔时间分样法,采用斜向深度回旋法,区块-对角(chunk-wise-wide)自取自取,从中层对中间预测进行调制. 培训要点是只使用公开的数据,新使用的Muon优化器,以及平衡的数据抽样。 推论速度包括用线性地层来取而代之地取出1×1相变,并优化Conformer区块的注意力计算. 集体来说,这些结果形成了一种模式,在英语短式ASR的开通ASR前导板上速度精确的Pareto边框上,同时速度是最快的竞争对手的两倍. 该型号可在许可使用下使用并下载自https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech- 5.0-470m-turboctc.

articles.title: MATCH: Model-Aware Tool Learning with Curriculum Scheduling and Hierarchically Gated Rewards
articles.content: Tool learning enables large language models (LLMs) to use external tools for tasks beyond parametric knowledge. Reinforcement learning can optimize tool-call behavior from feedback, but current methods still face two problems: fixed-threshold curricula can become misaligned with the policy's evolving capability boundary, and additive rewards can leak argument-level credit when the predicted tool is wrong. To address these problems, we propose MATCH, a closed-loop framework for model-aware tool learning with curriculum scheduling and hierarchically gated rewards. Model-Aware Curriculum Learning (MACL) maintains reward-derived sample difficulty that co-evolves with the policy, and each epoch selects samples near the current capability boundary together with a top-k pool of harder cases. Hierarchical Tool-call Gated Reward (HTGR) scores tool name, argument key, and argument value as a gated chain, granting credit at each level only when prerequisites hold. The same HTGR rewards drive both GRPO updates and MACL's difficulty refresh, closing the loop between policy optimization and sample scheduling. On API-Bank and BFCL V3, MATCH reaches 72.19% and 62.87% overall accuracy, outperforming the main supervised and RL-based baselines. Backbone experiments further show consistent improvements across four backbones from two model families.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MATCH: 示范实用工具学习,课程安排和分级奖励
articles.content_zh: 工具学习使得大型语言模型(LLMs)能够使用外部工具完成超出参数化知识的任务. 强化学习可以从反馈中优化工具调用行为,但目前的方法仍然面临两个问题:固定阈值课程可能与政策不断发展的能力界限错配,而添加剂奖励在预测工具出错时会泄露辩证等级信用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用MATCH这一封闭式框架,通过课程安排和分级奖励来学习了解模型的工具。 Model-Aware Course Learning(MACL)保持与政策共同演化的从奖励衍生的样本难度,每个纪元都会在当前能力边界附近选取样本,并配有一串顶级的更难案例. 分级工具调用 Gated Reward (HTGR) 得分工具名, 参数键, 和参数值作为入门链, 只有在前提条件存在时, 才能在每个级别发放信用 。 同样的HTGR奖励驱动了GPRO的更新和MACL的难度刷新,关闭了政策优化和样本调度之间的循环. 在API-Bank和BFCL V3上,MATCH达到72.19%和62.87%的总准确度,比主要监督基线和基于RL的基线要好。 后骨实验进一步显示,两个模范家庭的4个骨干持续改善.

articles.title: Reading Emotions in the Token Space: Discriminative Adaptation of SpeechLLMs for Emotion Recognition
articles.content: SpeechLLMs have shown strong potential for emotion recognition, yet they read the predicted emotion off a generative decoder not suited for classification: it can emit labels outside the target set and favors frequent classes. We propose a discriminative adaptation that reads the final prompt token's hidden state through a classification head, producing a label in one forward pass without modifying the backbone. Because this readout starts from the hidden state the model would otherwise decode, it gives a controlled comparison of generative and discriminative inference in an otherwise identical speechLLM. We keep the head a single linear layer, trading little accuracy for interpretability: each emotion becomes one direction in the LLM output token space, revealing associated tokens. On IEMOCAP, across two speechLLM architectures, it improves Macro F1 and removes hallucinations, with largest gains on realistic ASR transcripts. Our analysis reveals that these emotion directions encode indirect associations mirroring biases in web-scale text.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在Token空间读取情感:歧视性地修改SpeechLLMs以获得情感识别
articles.content_zh: SpeechLLMs显示出强烈的情感识别潜力,然而他们从一个不适于分类的基因解码器上读取了预言的情感:它可以在目标设定外放出标签并倾向于频繁的分类. 我们提出一种带有歧视性的修改,通过分类头来读取最终的即时信号所隐藏的状态,在不修改主干线的情况下,在一条前行道中产生出一个标签. 由于这个读取是从隐藏状态开始的,模型本来会解码,所以在原本相同的语音LLM中,它给出了基因论和歧义论的可控比较. 我们把头保持为单一的线性地层,用很少的精确度来解释: 每一种情感都变成LLM输出符号空间的一个方向,揭示相关的符号. 在IEMOCAP上,跨越了两个语音LLM架构,它改进了Macro F1并去除幻觉,在现实的ASR笔录上收获最大. 我们的分析表明,这些情感方向编码间接关联,反映了网络尺度文本中的偏差.

articles.title: Marginal utility, matrix factorization, and the Key-Value (KV) cache: a unified information-economic framework for sovereign geo-mining inference
articles.content: This paper builds a theoretical bridge between the economic notion of marginal utility and two machine-learning constructs, matrix factorization and the Key--Value cache of transformer language models. The singular value spectrum of a rating matrix is shown to be a diminishing marginal utility schedule for latent factors, the eigenvalue spectrum of the projected covariance operator to be the marginal utility schedule of a model's learned representation, and cache eviction and low-rank cache compression to be instances of constrained utility maximization under a memory budget. The three collapse into a single allocation rule: retain the top dimensions whose eigenvalue exceeds the shadow price of the binding constraint. The framework is applied to the automated extraction of structured information from geo-mining documents, where it motivates a multi-pass inference protocol, a layer-wise TIES model merging procedure, and a selection policy combining extraction quality, localization drift and energy, scalarized with a Conditional Value-at-Risk term on drift. Two empirical contributions are reported. An 11.2-million-parameter hierarchical classifier, trained in about five minutes on a single GPU, reaches 90.0 per cent level-1 accuracy on a held-out test set from a 973-document uranium-exploration corpus, against 92.0 per cent for a proprietary model on a fifty-document human audit of the same corpus, at a latency of 2.62 ms per card against approximately 2,000 ms for the API and at negligible cost. A diagnostic of uniform-density TIES merging exposes a reproducible degenerate mode in which the merged model returns token-identical outputs across five geographically distinct districts while declaring high confidence; re-executing the merge under layer-wise calibrated densities removes that signature on the diagnostic sample. The full-scale extraction benchmark, including LoRA fine-tuning, is reported as projected rather than measured and remains an empirical extension of this work.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 边际效用、矩阵因素化和Key-Value(KV)缓存:主权地矿推断的统一信息经济框架
articles.content_zh: 本文在边际效用的经济概念与两个机器学习构造,矩阵因子化和变压器语言模型的Key-Value缓存之间建立了理论桥梁. 评级矩阵的单值谱显示,潜在因素的边际效用表正在减少,预计共变操作器的等值谱显示为模型所学表现的边际效用表,缓存拆迁和低等缓存压缩显示为内存预算下受限效用最大化的情况. 三倒向单一分配规则:保留其等元值超过约束的影子价格的顶维. 该框架适用于从地矿文件中自动取出结构化信息,其中它推动采用多通道推论协议,采用分层的TIES模式合并程序,以及结合取取质量、本地化漂移和能耗的选取政策,在漂移时采用有条件的 " 危险值 " 一词来缩放。 报告了两项经验贡献。 在一个单一的GPU上经过大约5分钟培训的1120万参数级分类器,在973个文件铀勘探装置的搁置测试中达到90.0%的精确度;在同一装置的50个文件人审计中,专利模型的精确度为92.0%,每张卡的延迟度为2.62米,而API大约为2 000米,成本可忽略不计。 对统一密度的TIES合并的诊断暴露出一种可复制的退化模式,即合并模型在宣布高度信任的同时,在五个地理上不同的地区返回象征性的等同产出;在分层校正密度下重新执行合并可消除诊断样本上的签名。 包括LORA微调在内的全面提取基准报告为预测,而不是衡量,仍然是这项工作的经验延伸。

articles.title: AI Should Facilitate Democratic Deliberation at Scale
articles.content: AI systems can strengthen democracy by supporting deliberation at scale by addressing cognitive, social, platform-design, and market-driven frictions, while preserving human agency. Unlike proposals such as liquid democracy that restructure representation through vote delegation, in this position paper, we argue that AI-assisted deliberation offers a more promising path by lowering barriers to meaningful engagement without substituting machine judgment for human choice. Drawing on evidence from online deliberation platforms and experimental research, we identify four guiding principles: preserving agency and autonomy, encouraging mutual respect, promoting equality and inclusiveness, and augmenting rather than substituting active citizenship. We also address critical challenges, including alignment, sycophancy, training bias, and over-reliance on AI systems. We call on the machine learning community to develop deliberation-focused AI systems evaluated not on engagement metrics but on their capacity to facilitate informed, representative, and friction-robust discourse.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大赦国际应促进规模的民主审议
articles.content_zh: 人工智能系统可以通过解决认知、社会、平台设计和市场驱动的摩擦,同时保护人的能力,支持规模化的审议,从而加强民主。 与通过投票代表团重组代表制的液力民主等提案不同,我们在本立场文件中认为,大赦国际协助的审议提供了一个更有希望的途径,降低了阻碍有意义参与的障碍,而不是用机器判断来代替人类的选择。 我们利用在线审议平台和实验研究的证据,确定了四项指导原则:维护机构和自主权,鼓励相互尊重,促进平等和包容性,以及增强而不是取代积极的公民意识。 我们还应对重大挑战,包括调整、相互配合、培训偏向和过度依赖人工智能系统。 我们呼吁机器学习界建立以审议为重点的AI系统,评价的不是关于参与的衡量标准,而是关于它们促进知情、有代表性和摩擦力的对话的能力。

articles.title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents
articles.content: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone reaches 66.6%, placing the gain in the set-level policy, not the computation. From frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool, the lead is 5.0 points. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from an otherwise complete set costs 12.3 and 11.1 points of repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

articles.title_zh: 缺少的补充:国家规定的编码代理人最低限度的充分证据
articles.content_zh: 一个编码代理在某期的中途 已经读取者排名最高的部分了 关联性每经都得分,但充足性属于集:分级者可以以一个需要的事实的变体来填充其预算,并让决定不支持. 我们提出有条件的最低限度证据回收:鉴于一个被捕获的特工状态,回收一个紧凑的证据组合,为下一个决定仍然缺乏的支持提供依据。 SER Bench在45个储存库的500个搁置状态上测量了这一点,记录了代理人所看到的情况,并且只记录了涵盖当前决定要求的每个事实的套件。 MSS-Conceptation将收购视为设定构造,而不是排名. 3个语义调调提出一个共同的足够集,寻找所缺少的东西,并在6,144个令牌内还原出4-8个完整的源单位. 一种配置固定在校正数据上,在5个项目中为73.0%的州回收一套,在8个项目中回收80.6%的州回收一套,而在重新排序的Qune3中则回收61.4%和72.4%。 仅通过相似性进行匹配的控制排名就达到66.6%,将收益放在设定级别政策中,而不是计算中. 从没有出自金子的被冻结的存放地来源,领先点为5.0分. 在AMA-Bench上,它从76.2%的更小的回答快取答案,准确度高于该基准本身的内存代理的2.08分. 在两个执行器下,将一组所需设备从一套设备中去除12.3和11.1个修理地点精确点。 对代理人的追索最好被说成是收回裁决所缺乏的东西,而不是重新排列问题的性质。

articles.title: Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models
articles.content: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.

articles.title_zh: 大语文模式的地缘政治司
articles.content_zh: 人们越来越多地求助于AI聊天机来了解世界事件的新闻和解释. 但当他们用不同语言提问时,他们是否得到同样的政治答案? 在这里,我们表明一个问题的语言可以改变同样的AI系统如何评估乌克兰的战争. 我们要求GPT,克洛德和双子座用112种语言评价了20个关于战争的声明,收集了67,200个回复. 不同语言的俄罗斯-清代和乌克兰-清代答复的平衡有所不同. 当我们把各国官方语言的反应组合起来时,它们遵循了类似世界范围政治分歧的模式:相对而言,寻找俄罗斯的答案更符合俄罗斯更有利的公众观点,联合国选票对乌克兰的支持较少,对乌克兰的援助也较少。 所有三种模式都出现大模式,在删除单个对声明时仍然存在。 我们的调查结果表明,信息战可能通过某种途径塑造用来训练AI模型的文本,而这又可能传播地缘政治偏见。

articles.title: Benchmarking LLM Compliance with China AI Generated Content Regulations
articles.content: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content. This paper follows China's current AI-Generated content compliance requirements and provides evaluation results on 20 notable LLMs, offering insight into China's regulatory landscape. We design a novel framework to assess the compliance and refusal rates with 2303 questions spanning six distinct dimensions, including 203 self-constructed constitutional questions. The framework employs several judges to generate verdicts independently based on their hierarchical alignment memory. Our findings show that international models also exhibit high levels of compliance despite the use of standard Chinese questions, and the main differences may stem from dimensions closely related to ideological alignment. We establish a regulatory benchmark that enables the global AI community to evaluate both Chinese and non-Chinese LLMs under a unified set of legally grounded compliance requirements.

articles.title_zh: B. 衡量LLM 遵守中国AI生成内容条例
articles.content_zh: 广泛采用LLMS导致内容合规风险上升. 前作为在英语背景下应对这些风险做出了贡献,低估了汉语内容的复杂性. 本文遵循了中国现行的AI-Generated内容合规要求,并提供了对20个值得注意的有限责任公司的评价结果,为中国的监管格局提供了深刻的见解. 我们设计了一个新的框架,评估遵守率和拒绝率,涉及涉及六个不同层面的2303个问题,包括203个自我构建的宪法问题。 该框架聘请了几位法官,根据他们的等级调整记忆独立生成判决. 我们的调查结果表明,尽管使用了标准的中文问题,但国际模式也表现出高度遵守,主要差异可能来自与意识形态相密切联系的维度. 我们制定了管理基准,使全球AI社区能够根据一套统一的、有法律依据的遵守要求,评价中国和非中国的有限责任公司。

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
articles.content: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline. In addition, we streamline the DeepSeek-V4 architecture and introduce several efficient architectural extensions. We pretrain DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens and conduct comprehensive post-training, yielding strong performance across diverse text-based and multimodal agentic scenarios. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

articles.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash:推开 KV缓存压缩的极限
articles.content_zh: 广泛采用长视距物剂使模型工作量越来越多投入。 虽然先前的工作已大大减少了长文本计算的成本,但预填仍然在计算上昂贵,而大量的KV缓存继续使HBM和SSD容量和数据传输带宽紧张. 这些计算、储存和带宽需求共同构成进一步降低部署费用的主要瓶颈。 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,一种具有552B主干参数的多式混合型(MoE)模型,并支持多达一百万个令牌的环境. 以其Causal Encoder-Decoder(CED)架构,该模型在解码时激活了每令牌16B个参数,但在预填时只激活了8B个参数,大大提高了代理工作量的成本效益. 为了推动KV缓存压缩的极限,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在压缩Sparse Content 2 (CSA2)中将跨层的KV缓存再利用与FP4 KV缓存结合. 这些设计将其全球KV缓存足迹(常以HBM为单位)减少到每令牌890字节,大约为DeepSeek-V4-Flash相应足迹的1/4. 此外,通过被称为SWA Bunded Replay的专用部署优化,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash将其持久的KV缓存足迹(总是在SSD上或主机内存上)减少到了DeepSeek-V4-Flash的大约1/8. 尽管KV缓存足迹要小得多,但该模型的性能大大高于基线。 此外,我们精简了DeepSeek-V4建筑,并引入了几个高效的建筑扩展. 我们预先将DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash训练在由45T令牌组成的多式文书上,并进行全面的后期培训,在各种基于文本和多式代理方案之间产生强有力的业绩。 示范检查站见https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/Deepseek-V4.1-Flash。
